name: Dumbbell Side-Lying External Rotation
steps: Lie on one side on the bench with your head supported and a dumbbell in your top hand.
Tuck your top elbow against your ribs bent at a right angle, forearm resting across your abdomen.
Rotate your shoulder outward to lift the dumbbell smoothly toward the ceiling, then lower under control.
Finish the working arm, then turn onto your other side and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbow tucked against your ribs throughout the rotation.
End the lift before your torso starts to roll backward.
